## Change and reason

Describe the user-visible result and the relevant tradeoff. Link the issue.

## Validation

Record commands, CI results and meaningful limits. Use synthetic data only.

## Independent review

Record reviewer scope, findings and their resolution. Do not mark a review
complete until an independent reviewer has actually returned it.

## Scope

Confirm whether this changes storage, time interpretation or offline assets.
Confirm that files, examples, discussion text and artifacts contain no personal
infrastructure or private operational details. Use synthetic test data.
Publication settings require separate maintainer approval.
